question: Identify the top 10 Citibike stations by highest proportion of group rides, defined as trips starting and ending at the same station where multiple riders departed/arrived within the same 2-minute time window. Calculate the proportion as the number of trips that are part of a group divided by the total number of trips ending at that station.
sql:
-- Use station_id as the grouping key for proportions, pick most common name
WITH same_station AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    start_station_name,
    starttime,
    stoptime,
    bikeid,
    TIMESTAMP_ADD(
      TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(starttime, HOUR, "UTC"),
      INTERVAL (DIV(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM starttime), 2) * 2) MINUTE
    ) as bucket_2min
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    bucket_2min,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM same_station
  GROUP BY start_station_id, bucket_2min
),
group_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.start_station_id,
    CASE WHEN bc.cnt > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_group
  FROM same_station ss
  JOIN bucket_counts bc 
    ON ss.start_station_id = bc.start_station_id 
    AND ss.bucket_2min = bc.bucket_2min
),
station_group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    SUM(is_group) as group_rides
  FROM group_trips
  GROUP BY start_station_id
),
station_total_end AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY end_station_id
),
station_names AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    end_station_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY end_station_id ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM (
    SELECT end_station_id, end_station_name, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY end_station_id, end_station_name
  )
)
SELECT 
  s.end_station_id as station_id,
  sn.end_station_name as station_name,
  s.total_trips,
  COALESCE(g.group_rides, 0) as group_rides,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(g.group_rides, 0), s.total_trips), 6) as proportion
FROM station_total_end s
JOIN station_names sn ON s.end_station_id = sn.end_station_id AND sn.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN station_group_counts g ON s.end_station_id = g.start_station_id
WHERE s.total_trips > 0
ORDER BY proportion DESC
LIMIT 10
